items.markdown:
![Your Essential Hoi Tod (Fried Mussels) Recipe - Exotic Food ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280736-1672-0139-0000-fc1cd2180f7f:6)
Hoi Tod is `a popular Thai street food dish featuring a crispy fried pancake made with seafood, eggs, and bean sprouts` . It typically highlights fresh mussels or oysters mixed into an airy starch batter.[](https://www.exoticfoodthailand.com/hoi-tod-recipe/) [[1]](https://www.exoticfoodthailand.com/hoi-tod-recipe/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2mcfGTXYflM)[[3]](https://hungryinthailand.com/fried-mussels-recipe-hoi-tod/)

Key Ingredients and Styles

- **Seafood:** Fresh small mussels (*hoi malaeng phu* ) or plump oysters (*hoi nang rom*).
- **Batter:** A mix of rice flour, cornstarch or tapioca starch, and ice-cold water for crunch.
- **Vegetables:** Crunchy bean sprouts and chopped spring onions.
- **Textures:** Served either extra crispy and golden or soft and chewy.[](https://www.exoticfoodthailand.com/hoi-tod-recipe/) [[1]](https://www.flyinggoosebrand.com/learn-how-to-make-a-crispy-thai-oyster-omelette/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/i342W5P8iGI)

How It Is Served

- **Sauce:** Drizzled or dipped with tangy Thai sriracha or sweet chili sauce.
- **Garnish:** Topped with a dash of white pepper and fresh cilantro.[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/restaurants/pad-thai-intervention-hoy-tod-better-pad-thai/) [[1]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/restaurants/pad-thai-intervention-hoy-tod-better-pad-thai/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/CookingwithYui/videos/-cooking-hoi-tod-thai-crispy-mussels-with-jj-foodservice-limited-bookmarked-and-/1024190609067415/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRNj3YyiM9G/)

items.title: What is hoi tod?

expanded_element.title: Learn How to Make a Crispy Thai Oyster Omelette
expanded_element.description: Hoi tod is a crispy Thai oyster pancake or omelette that many tourists and visitors in the coastal areas of Thailand fall in love with. The beginnings of hoi tod can be traced to Chinese immigrants who migrated to the country's coasts many years ago.

items.title: What does hoi tod taste like?

expanded_element.title: Your Essential Hoi Tod (Fried Mussels) Recipe
expanded_element.description: A Hoi Tod recipe is incomplete without a generous drizzle of sweet chilli sauce. This condiment is a staple in Thai cuisine, loved for its balance of sweetness and mild heat. The sweetness of the chilli sauce pairs beautifully with the briny mussels, while its slight tang cuts through the richness of the fried batter.
